_note: Hand-maintained fields with no free no-login feed. fetch_data.py only reads this file, never writes it. Update the relevant entry's value/actual and as_of right before or after the matching release; leave a field null if you haven't set it yet.

rbi_repo_rate._source: Set at the Oct 7 2026 MPC meeting (hiked from 5.25%) after Aug CPI ran hot; reporting as of mid-Nov expects another 25bp hike at the Dec 4 2026 meeting since Oct CPI broke above the 6% ceiling. Verify/update before Dec 4 - this is a forecast, not a fact.

india_cpi._source: MoSPI release: Oct 2026 CPI YoY 6.09% (provisional), first print above RBI's 6% ceiling since Oct 2024; Sep 2026 was 5.54%.

india_gsec10y._source: Press-cited (tradingeconomics.com), not from an exact free API - treat as approximate, update when you have a sharper number.

consensus._note: Fill in shortly before each release so the dashboard can show the surprise (actual - expected). us_cpi/us_pce are YoY %, us_jobs is payrolls added in thousands, us_gdp is annualized QoQ %.
